findings.title: Reconcile proven shared recovery with the graph attempt latch
findings.scenario: A graph run reaches STOP_UNCONFIRMED, then its generation later obtains a valid terminal Job0 receipt. Shared recovery confirms stopped and clears ActivityAdmission/connection. The graph state remains activity.stop=unknown, so the same scope cannot generate again, including after reopen.
evidence: src/main/index.ts:149 clears only ActivityAdmission after shared proof; :232 confirms only connection recovery.
src/core/graph-coordinator.ts has no recovery reconciliation path and reuses the previous GraphState at :34-37.
src/core/bmad-graph.ts:52 rejects activity.stop=unknown even with globalGuard=clear; restoreGraphState preserves unknown.
src/renderer/src/GraphPanel.ts:18,29 permanently disable generate and revalidate for that state.
findings.requestedChange: Add a host-only reconciliation tied to the actual owned generation and confirmed shared recovery. Preserve historical result/freshness and require explicit generation; do not infer stop from the analysis Promise.

findings.title: Include the current supervision observation when a later child throws
findings.scenario: The analysis child completes, populating states. The subsequent terminal-capture child starts, but Invoke-BmadSupervised throws in its finally (e.g. final receipt persistence fails). Its current state is ignored because states is already nonempty. If that last child lacks job_active_after_stop=0, the launcher still emits jobActive=0 using the first child alone.
evidence: launcher.ps1:24-25 appends current only after Invoke-BmadSupervised returns.
launcher.ps1:46 includes the fallback current state only when states.Count=0.
supervision.ps1:211,219-220 can throw from finally before the return at :222.
launcher.ps1:47-50 then bases terminal jobActive solely on previously returned states; GraphOwnedRun accepts that terminal as stopped.
findings.requestedChange: Always include the current attempted child observation, avoiding duplicate returned observations. Every started child without assigned-before-resume and proven Job0 must keep the aggregate unknown.
